title: Magnetars
description: A star's core collapses to a neutron star and its field is squeezed with it, flux conserved: a thousand times stronger than any magnet made on Earth, a billion times. Starquakes crack its crust.

puzzle.goal: A core of radius R threaded by a field B collapses to radius r, keeping all the field lines through it. Write the field b it ends with.
puzzle.name: Flux freezing
puzzle.ask: Find b in units of 10⁹ T (u = @{u}) for B = @{B} T, R = @{R} m, r = 1e4 m.
puzzle.method: The flux Φ = Bπr² through the star is frozen into its conducting plasma, so B grows as 1/r².
